title: Merlin's Crystal
start: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot.

items.t: All the following items can be acquired during the quest:
Bread (Can be obtained during the quest with 24 coins)
Bat bones (Can be obtained during the quest)
If getting the black candle from Wendle's Wicks:
If getting the black candle from Catherby:
Bucket (Can be obtained during the quest)
Insect repellent (Can be obtained during the quest)
Can be used off of the toolbelt if already added

recommended.t: Activated Falador, Seers' Village and Varrock lodestone

kills.t: Thrantax the Mighty (level 70); only if the player gives an incorrect answer

rewards.t: A replica of Excalibur will be placed in the Varrock Museum as a Varrock Museum display by talking to Historian Minas. This will give you 5 Kudos and an antique lamp that gives 1,000 experience in a skill of level 20 or above.

steps.t: Talk to King Arthur at Camelot. [Chat: 1 I'm looking for a quest. › Accept]
Talk to Sir Gawain nearby. Ask him how Merlin got stuck in the crystal. [Chat: 3 Do you know how Merlin got trapped? › 2 Thank you for the information!]
Go upstairs, and talk to Sir Lancelot. Ask if he has any ideas on getting into Keep Le Faye. [Chat: 3 Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?]
Hide in the crate just west of the candle-maker in Catherby. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Yes.]
Climb to the top floor.

Attack Sir Mordred until his health drops to 0. If you use bleeds/poisons/conjures, future dialogue will be interrupted until the bleed/poison effect ends. Aggressive familiars would continue to attack when Sir Mordred goes back to full health after reaching 0 health, thus restarting the fight.
Talk to Morgan Le Faye. Spare Mordred's life to discover how to save Merlin. [Chat: 1 Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might. › 2 Okay, I will do that.]
If you do not have bat bones, exit the keep to the west and kill a Giant bat.
Talk to the candle-maker in Catherby. [Chat: 1 Have you got any black candles?]
Gather a bucket of wax from the beehives to the north-west. A bucket can be found at the beehives.

sub.t: If you do not have insect repellent then speak to the beekeeper for some. You can also add it to your tool belt.

steps.t: Left click the hive to use insect repellent on it and then use an empty bucket on a beehive to fill the bucket.
Talk to the candle-maker again to get the black candle from him.
Talk to the Lady of the Lake in southern Taverley. Ask about the sword Excalibur. [Chat: 2 I seek the sword Excalibur.]
Go to Port Sarim.

sub.t: If you don't have bread, buy a loaf from Wydin's Food Store, just south of the Port Sarim lodestone.

steps.t: Enter Grum's Gold Exchange to the north of Port Sarim lodestone.
Give the beggar your bread. [Chat: 1 Yes certainly.]
The beggar will turn into the Lady of the Lake and give you Excalibur for your good deed.
Go to the Temple of Zamorak south of the Varrock east bank.
Check the chaos altar's inscription.
Return to Camelot and enter the gates.
Run north-east outside of the castle to the ritual site (the gazebo outside the castle).
Stand on the star and light the black candle.
Drop the bat bones on the star.

The magic words are "Snarthon Candtrick Termanto". If you get this wrong, you will have to get the black candle remade; or click away before proceeding with the dialogue and re-drop the bat bones to try again.
Enter the castle and climb the top of the south-east tower.
Smash the giant crystal to free Merlin.
Talk to King Arthur.
Quest complete!
